eval.question: Which open account was reconciled least recently, and what is its current balance?
eval.expected: Call get-accounts, exclude closed accounts, choose the greatest non-null daysSinceReconciliation, and report its balance and lastReconciledAt.

eval.question: List accounts that have not been reconciled in the last 30 days, then show this month's transactions for the stalest one.
eval.expected: Call get-accounts, filter by daysSinceReconciliation greater than 30, then call get-transactions with the selected account ID and a current-month date range.

eval.question: Are any active accounts missing a reconciliation date? If so, compare their balances.
eval.expected: Call get-accounts, filter out closed accounts, identify lastReconciledAt null, and compare the balances already returned without inventing a date.

eval.question: For my most recently reconciled on-budget account, summarize spending by category over the last month.
eval.expected: Call get-accounts, select the on-budget account with the smallest non-null age, then call spending-by-category with that account ID and the requested range.

eval.question: Compare the three stalest open accounts and give their three-month balance histories.
eval.expected: Call get-accounts, sort open accounts by reconciliation age, then call balance-history once for each of the three selected IDs.

eval.question: Inspect last year's transactions for the stalest account without requesting an unbounded transaction dump.
eval.expected: Call get-accounts, choose the stalest active account, then call get-transactions in bounded monthly or quarterly date ranges and continue only when more detail is needed.

eval.question: The account list has no reconciliation date for one account. Determine whether it is closed before recommending action.
eval.expected: Call get-accounts and use the same result's closed and lastReconciledAt fields; do not treat null as a fabricated date or invoke a write tool.

eval.question: If retrieving accounts fails because Actual cannot synchronize, what should you do before trying to analyze reconciliation age?
eval.expected: Call get-accounts once, report the actionable synchronization/authentication error, and do not substitute cached guesses or repeatedly retry.

eval.question: Check whether an off-budget investment account is overdue for reconciliation and summarize its recent balance movement.
eval.expected: Call get-accounts, identify the requested off-budget account and its reconciliation age, then call balance-history with includeOffBudget enabled.

eval.question: Prepare a concise monthly financial check-in that includes accounts overdue for reconciliation and the current monthly summary.
eval.expected: Call get-accounts to identify overdue accounts, call monthly-summary for the current period, and combine both results without modifying Actual.
